title: IT Systems Engineer
description:
**OVERVIEW**

The IT Systems Engineer is responsible for administering, supporting, and continuously improving eClinical Solutions' enterprise technology platforms and related infrastructure. The position also supports the company's core technology infrastructure, including servers, networks, switches, routers, wireless access points, firewalls, backup and recovery systems, and hosted services. Responsibilities include platform configuration, identity and access management, endpoint management, application integration, automation, monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational support.

The IT Systems Engineer works across functional and technical areas and may assume additional responsibilities based on evolving business, security, compliance, and operational needs.

**KEY TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Administer and support Microsoft 365, including Entra ID, Intune, Windows Autopilot, SharePoint Online, Teams, Exchange, Azure, and other services.
* Administer and support Atlassian platforms, including Jira, Jira Service Management (JSM), Assets, Confluence and other services.
* Configure and maintain platform workflows, forms, permissions, roles, groups, integrations, automation rules, and reporting capabilities.
* Manage identity and access controls, endpoint configuration, application deployment, device compliance, and user lifecycle processes.
* Support enterprise application integrations using APIs, connectors, scripting, and automation tools.
* Maintain and support network and infrastructure technologies, including servers, switches, routers, wireless access points, firewalls, DNS, DHCP, SFTP, and related services.
* Monitor enterprise platforms and infrastructure for availability, capacity, performance, security, and operational issues.
* Manage or support backup, recovery, disaster-recovery, and business-continuity technologies and procedures.
* Troubleshoot complex platform, endpoint, identity, integration, network, and infrastructure issues.
* Participate in incident, problem, change, vulnerability, compliance, and audit-management activities.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, configuration standards, operating procedures, recovery documentation, and knowledge articles.
* Research and recommend improvements to enterprise platforms, infrastructure, security controls, automation, and operational processes.
* Coordinate with IT Support, Information Security, Engineering, Application Operations, business stakeholders, and third-party providers.
* Other duties as assigned

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, or equivalent combination of education, professional training, certifications, and relevant work experience preferred.
* Five or more years of experience administering and supporting enterprise technology platforms, systems, networks, or related infrastructure, preferably within a SaaS technology company or regulated environment preferred.
* Experience supporting distributed users and technology services across multiple offices, regions, or time zones.
* Relevant professional certifications from Microsoft, Atlassian, AWS, Cisco, CompTIA, or similar providers are preferred.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

**Professional Skills**

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to take ownership of technical issues, coordinate the appropriate resources, and drive work through resolution.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to balance operational support, planned initiatives, and changing priorities.
* Ability to translate business and operational requirements into practical technical configurations and solutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Ability to develop and maintain clear technical documentation, operating procedures, system records, and knowledge articles.
* Strong attention to detail when administering permissions, configurations, integrations, and production technology services.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with IT Support, Information Security, Engineering, Application Operations, business stakeholders, and external service providers.
* Sound judgment when evaluating operational risk, security requirements, user impact, and competing priorities.
* Adaptability and willingness to learn, administer, and support new technologies as business needs evolve.
* Commitment to customer service, operational reliability, continuous improvement, and timely follow-through.
* Ability to participate effectively in incident response, change management, projects, audits, and cross-functional initiatives.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong administration and troubleshooting experience within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including Entra ID, Intune, Windows Autopilot, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and related Azure services.
* Experience administering Atlassian platforms such as Jira, Jira Service Management, Assets, and Confluence, including workflows, permissions, request types, forms, automation, and reporting.
* Strong understanding of identity and access management, including Active Directory, Entra ID, role-based access control, user and group administration, single sign-on, multifactor authentication, and user lifecycle processes.
* Experience managing endpoint configuration, compliance policies, application deployment, device enrollment, operating-system updates, and security settings.
* Working knowledge of enterprise networking and infrastructure technologies, including switches, routers, firewalls, wireless access points, virtual servers, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and SFTP.
* Experience supporting backup and recovery technologies, system monitoring, disaster-recovery processes, and business-continuity testing.
* Experience using PowerShell or other scripting and automation technologies to improve system administration and reduce repetitive manual work.
* Experience configuring and supporting integrations through APIs, webhooks, connectors, identity federation, or similar technologies.
* Understanding of information-security principles, endpoint protection, vulnerability remediation, encryption, logging, access controls, and system hardening.
* Experience troubleshooting complex problems involving enterprise platforms, endpoints, user identities, networks, integrations, and infrastructure.
* Ability to evaluate, learn, and effectively administer new technologies as organizational requirements evolve.

**AI Use Statement**

Employees are expected to appropriately leverage company-approved AI tools to improve productivity and quality while adhering to company policies, protecting confidential information, validating AI-generated content, and exercising sound professional judgment. AI is intended to augment—not replace—professional judgment, critical thinking, accountability, and decision-making. Accountability for all work remains with the employee.

title: Senior Power Systems Engineer
description:
**About Bidgely**
-----------------

We are an AI-powered, cloud-based SaaS solution provider that enables electric, gas and water utilities worldwide to personalize customer experiences, optimize grid and customer operations, and accelerate their journey towards the clean energy future. Headquartered in Silicon Valley, we serve some of the biggest names in the energy and utilities industry across the USA, Canada, the EU, the Middle East, India, Japan, Australia and New Zealand. We hold 25+ energy patents, have raised $77M+ in funding, and bring a passion for AI to utilities serving 35M+ customers and meters around the world.

Bidgely Grid Intelligence brings that same data to the distribution grid. It turns AMI-derived, appliance-level demand into a capacity view of the grid that answers how many MW a location can support, and whether a new load or DER can connect there — and on what terms. As electrification, DER adoption and data center growth reshape the grid, utilities need those answers faster and with more confidence than traditional planning cycles allow.

**Product overview:** https://www.bidgely.com/utilityai/ · Grid: https://www.bidgely.com/solutions/der-grid-planning/

**Position:** Senior Power Systems Engineer — Grid Model & Power Flow

**Role Overview**
-----------------

As a Senior Power Systems Engineer, you are a software engineer with deep power flow and grid planning expertise. You will build the product that lets utilities run capacity, scenario and interconnection studies — you will not run those studies by hand as a consultant would. You own the electrical correctness of everything the product produces, working alongside the Grid portfolio's software developers. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, with a dotted line to the Director of Product, Grid Planning, you will:

* Own how power flow is delivered inside the product: evaluate open-source and licensed solvers, recommend one, and integrate and operate it. We will not write our own solver.
* Build and maintain the capacity digital twin of the grid, including the data requirements and utility integrations that feed it.
* Build the scenario, forecasting, real loading and interconnection study capabilities planners use, on top of the twin and the power flow solution.
* Establish whether results are true: benchmark against sanctioned planning tools and field data, and defend results directly to utility planners and engineers.
* Run quick proofs of concept for grid planning solutions — a new study capability, a solver option or an interconnection approach — on a utility's own data in days, and turn what works into the production path.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Power Flow Solutioning**

* Evaluate open-source and licensed power flow engines against real feeders; benchmark results and quantify differences.
* Document what each engine can and cannot do at Bidgely's scale, and make the open-source or license recommendation with evidence.
* Integrate the chosen engine into the product and own its fit with the rest of Grid Intelligence.

### **Capacity Digital Twin**

* Build and maintain the capacity digital twin as a product capability: the engineered pipeline that turns a utility's connectivity model into a validated, versioned grid model the product runs studies on.
* Own the data need: define the network, asset, AMI, SCADA and forecast data the twin requires, the minimum viable data set, and how gaps are handled.
* Build the utility integrations that feed the twin — connectivity model exports (CIM, GIS and vendor formats), SCADA and AMI — and make them repeatable across utilities rather than bespoke per customer.
* Engineer meter–transformer–phase confidence and SCADA calibration into the twin, not as one-off analysis.
* Keep the twin scoped to capacity — not real-time operations or asset health — and versioned against the utility's system of record.
* Build the data-quality exception path so connectivity gaps surface as explicit flags, never as silently wrong numbers.

### **Scenarios, Forecasting and Real Loading**

* Build the scenario capability planners need for electrical studies: base, future, flexibility, contingency and switching cases constructed on the twin and comparable side by side.
* Turn forecasting into study-ready inputs: translate load, DER, EV, electrification and large-load forecasts into asset-level 8760 P/Q and phase cases, with low, base and high ranges and year of need.
* Engineer 8760 and time-series execution so planners can run scenarios at production scale, reliably and repeatably.
* Build the real loading model: hourly, per-phase loading on every asset from AMI-derived, appliance-level demand, reconciled to SCADA, with phase, coincidence, unmetered load and losses handled in the product rather than by hand.

### **Interconnection Study Capability**

* Build the product capability that lets a utility run interconnection studies for new load and DER on the capacity digital twin and the power flow solution.
* Engineer the study workflow: request profile and ramp intake, candidate point-of-interconnection mapping, headroom and hosting capacity screening, and existing-system and contingency impact checks.
* Build large-load and data center modeling into the product: phased energization, 8760 P/Q profiles, cooling and commissioning cases, and onsite generation, storage and UPS.
* Build flexible interconnection into the product: firm, phased, conditional and flexible service options, with import, ramp and curtailment envelopes.
* Make failed cases productive: the product proposes the repair or alternate connection path and packages engineer-ready cases for the utility's authoritative studies.

### **Engineering Quality and Validation**

* Own the technical design of the power flow, twin and study layer, working with the portfolio's developers on performance at scale, failure handling and observability.
* Build the QA and regression suite that proves a change did not move results.
* Benchmark against sanctioned planning tools and field expectation, and explain every divergence.
* Document assumptions, data lineage and model versioning to a standard that survives a planner's review and, eventually, a regulatory filing.

### **Rapid Proofs of Concept**

* Run quick proofs of concept for grid planning solutions on a utility's own data in days, not months: a new study capability, a solver option, or a data center interconnection approach.
* Label every shortcut, and turn the approaches that work into the production path.

### **Product Validation**

* Lead technical validation of pilots and proofs of value: define acceptance tests, use the product to produce the result, and defend it to utility planners and engineers.
* Partner with Product, which owns requirements and roadmap, by establishing whether each result is electrically true.
* Work with the GM, Grid and Data Science on the customer evidence that moves a utility to adopt.

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

### **Educational Background**

BTech or MTech in Electrical Engineering; power systems specialisation preferred.

### **Professional Experience**

* 5+ years in distribution system modeling or power systems analysis, including models built personally from imperfect source data.
* Hands-on with at least one distribution power flow tool: OpenDSS, CYME, Synergi, PowerFactory, PSSSINCAL or an ADMS power flow engine. We expect you to learn the others.
* Preferred, not required: has run or reviewed load or DER interconnection studies, covering screening, system impact, contingency performance and service options.
* Model validation experience: can benchmark one tool against another and explain the differences.
* Has worked in a production codebase alongside software developers, under code review, with tests and CI.
* Can turn a utility's raw data into a working study in days, with shortcuts made explicit.
* Utility consulting or EPC background with multi-utility exposure is strongly preferred.

### **Technical & Domain Expertise**

* Unbalanced three-phase distribution load flow: voltage bases, phase representation, equipment models, thermal and voltage limits, and reverse flow.
* Working knowledge of the distribution capacity planning cycle: what a planner does with a result, and what makes them reject one.
* Strongly preferred: large-load or data center interconnection, including phased energization and onsite generation or storage.
* Strongly preferred: flexible or non-firm interconnection — conditional service, curtailment envelopes and flexible connection agreements.
* Strongly preferred: connectivity model conversion at scale from CIM, GIS or vendor exports; AMI interval data and 8760 forecasting; DER hosting capacity; N-1 and switching analysis.
* Strongly preferred: Python, including profiling numerical code at scale, and experience evaluating or integrating a commercial solver SDK.

**Core Competencies**
---------------------

* Grid Expert – Brings a planner's judgment to an engineering team, and knows when a result is wrong before the test does.
* Product Builder – Turns study practice into product capability that utilities run themselves, rather than doing the study by hand.
* Rigorous Validator – Proves a result is right before it reaches a utility: benchmarks against trusted planning tools and field data, and explains every difference.
* Fast Builder – Moves from raw utility data to a credible answer in days, and knows which shortcuts are safe.
* Collaborative Engineer – Raises the grid fluency of the developers around them and works as one team with Product.

**Why Join Bidgely?**
---------------------

* Shape how utilities plan the grid through electrification, DER growth and the data center surge.
* Be the grid authority on a product that turns AMI data into planning decisions.
* Competitive compensation, benefits and opportunities for professional growth.
* Work at the intersection of AI, data and power systems engineering.

**Ready to Apply?**
-------------------

If you know the distribution grid well enough to defend a power flow result to a utility planner, and you want to build the product that makes those studies faster and more trustworthy, we'd love to meet you.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
Working closely with Operations, Engineering, Product, and Infrastructure teams, the Systems Engineer 2 (IC2) will be responsible for supporting, maintaining, and optimizing enterprise Citrix infrastructure and virtual application delivery environments supporting Oracle Health customers.
  
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with **Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops , Windows Server administration, Active Directory, Group Policy (GPO), virtualization technologies, and networking fundamentals** . The role requires strong troubleshooting capabilities, experience supporting production environments, and the ability to resolve standard technical issues independently while following established policies and procedures.
  
The position involves providing Citrix **prod support** for Oracle Health customer environments, ensuring system availability, operational stability, performance, and security. Key activities include incident and service request management, monitoring, system administration, troubleshooting, software updates, patching, upgrades, and customer change management.
  
The successful candidate will also support Oracle Applications and legacy applications, respond to application-related service requests, coordinate testing of application releases, document defects, and collaborate with IT and Development teams to resolve issues. The role may include user training, application access administration, reporting, and participation in operational meetings as required.
  
The candidate will contribute to root cause analysis (RCA), on-call support, automation initiatives, technical documentation, and continuous improvement activities aimed at improving service reliability and reducing operational effort.
  
This role requires effective communication, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, customer-focused Citrix environment.

  

**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Incident Management & Support – Service Request:**

* Supports the end-to-end incident management lifecycle to ensure systems are stable, secure, and performing accurately.
* May participate in incident review meetings to understand and provide some feedback for operational performance and solution implementation.
* Engages with cross-functional teams (e.g., Development, Cloud Engineering, Product Engineering, other IT teams) to support implementation and/or resolution for incidents, risks, or migrations.

**Production Support and Incident Management**

* Provide 12x7 production support for Oracle Health customer environments, ensuring system availability, reliability, and operational continuity.
* Manage incidents, service requests (SRs), and customer escalations, ensuring timely investigation, resolution, and communication.
* Participate in on-call support for critical production incidents and service restoration activities.
* Troubleshoot Citrix application delivery, virtual desktop access, user session, connectivity, and infrastructure-related issues.

**Change Management and Customer Support**

* Execute approved customer change management activities, including planned maintenance, infrastructure upgrades, and go-live support.
* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Technical Program Managers (TPMs), and Infrastructure teams during customer-impacting activities.
* Ensure changes are implemented in accordance with established change management policies and procedures.
* Perform pre-change and post-change validation to confirm system functionality and service availability.
* Communicate maintenance progress, risks, and technical issues to relevant stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), troubleshooting guides, and operational runbooks.

**System Installation & Configuration – Software Administration:**

* Maintains operating systems to ensure effective installation and performance as instructed.
* Assists in the administration of middleware products in environments.
* Begins to support the deployment, maintenance, and operation of internal applications as needed.
* Performs regular administration and conducts basic performance trend analyses and server capacity to ensure service performance meets standards.
* Builds working knowledge of application monitoring tools to ensure efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* **3 to 5 years of related experience** in a medium to large distributed network and computing environment.
* Bachelor’s degree (BS) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience working with enterprise servers and systems.
* Hands-on experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) or similar application virtualization technologies.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Knowledge of Windows Operating Systems
* Experience with cloud infrastructure such as OCI, AWS or Azure is an added advantage.
* Basic networking knowledge
* Able to work in a collaborative team environment.
* Experience with Windows Server patching, security vulnerability remediation, and infrastructure upgrades.
* Understanding of ITIL-based incident, problem, and change management practices.

title: Lead Systems Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Lead Systems Engineer** to lead the system engineering function across our automotive electronics product portfolio, including Battery Management Systems, On-board/Off-board Chargers, Motor Controller Units, TCU, DC-DC Converters, and Vehicle Control Units.

**The candidate will own system-level engineering deliverables** throughout the product development lifecycle, from customer requirement analysis and system architecture definition to implementation, integration, verification, validation, and production release.

The role requires strong expertise in automotive system architecture, requirements engineering, functional decomposition, interface management, system modeling, risk analysis, and V-model-based development. The candidate will work closely with customer system and vehicle architects, hardware and software engineering teams, functional safety, testing and validation, quality, and project management teams to ensure that product requirements are complete, traceable, technically feasible, and verifiable.

The candidate will also be responsible for establishing and improving system engineering processes, mentoring the system engineering team, and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality system engineering artifacts across projects.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Work closely with (customers') system and vehicle architects to understand and derive system requirements
* Define functional requirements, technical requirements, robustness and reliability requirements for the product
* Conduct systems- failure modes and effects analysis (SFMEA) and design-failure modes and effects analysis (DFMEA)
* Modeling system level and vehicle level use cases and maintaining version controlled summary of traceability
* Deriving system state and mode flow machine and behavior of the product and its effect on vehicle for each state and mode
* Preparing logical architecture and technical architecture with component owners ensuring internal alignment among each component owners
* Preparing signal interface specifications for each derived signals interacting between the logical and physical components
* Hands on with implementing V-cycle
* Good knowledge on safety standards ISO-26262 and cybersecurity standards
* Review and communicate the requirements with HW teams, SW teams, test teams, customers.
* Mentor, hire, and train the system engineers.

**Must-Have Requirements**
--------------------------

* Bachelors or Masters in electronic or similar engineering with 10+ years of experience.
* Minimum hands on experience of system engineering for 3 products from requirement phase to production.
* Good understanding of automotive architecture, electrical and electronic systems within automotive electric vehicles- EVs and HEVs
* Basic know how on battery management systems
* Hands on with any automotive function development
* Good understanding on interfaces like CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, Microcontroller architectures, DC-DC converters, electronic control units, relay drivers, solid state relays/ PDU, automotive ethernet, UDS diagnostics protocol, OBD, etc
* Team player and good at cross functional work abilities
* Capable of defining the process of handling the requirements with the help of project management and technical management
* Hands on with DOORs or any other requirement management tools
* Awareness on ISO26262 functional safety and cyber security ISO21434 implementation.

title: Products & Systems Engineer

title: Principal Systems Engineer - AI/GPU infrastructure
description:

title: Information Systems Engineer
description:
**Overview**  
**About Business Unit:**  
At the core of all that Epsilon does is a team that sets the foundation of our IT infrastructure. The team drives innovation and efficiency through pioneering technology across Epsilon's platforms and business verticals. From being the first point of contact for infrastructure needs to final deployment, the team provides end-to-end solutions for our client-facing platforms. ETS supports all aspects of revenue-generating platforms for Epsilon and sets the architectural direction for our enterprise deployments. By adopting the newest technologies, such as Cloud, Automation, and Artificial Intelligence, the team is at the front of redefining our digital business and capturing new opportunities.
  
  
**Summary:**  
As an integral member of the Infrastructure Transition Team within our enterprise IT organization, you will provide comprehensive support and deliver end-to-end infrastructure services across cloud environments, operating systems, network, virtualization, and operational integrations.
  
  
You will actively engage in project activities including feasibility analysis, scoping, scheduling, and task management. The role will contribute to the end-to-end infrastructure lifecycle, including server provisioning, onboarding, configuration, integration, migration, operational readiness, and secure decommissioning. A key focus will be eliminating repetitive manual activities through scripting, Infrastructure as Code, orchestration, and reusable automation solutions.
  
  
This position requires close collaboration with Architecture, Operations, Security, IAM, Network, Cloud, Application, Project Management and Client teams to ensure that infrastructure solutions are technically sound, operationally ready, and aligned with measurable business outcomes.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience delivering infrastructure solutions across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments, with strong expertise in automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevOps practices, and operational excellence.
  
  
Clear and timely communication with users and management regarding the status of ongoing activities is vital to maintain transparency and ensure project success.
  
  
Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* Provide engineering support for Windows and Linux platforms, ensuring secure, reliable, and scalable infrastructure operations.
* Lead server lifecycle management, including onboarding, integration, migration, and decommissioning, using automation to improve efficiency and reduce operational risk.
* Drive infrastructure automation and DevOps adoption through reusable solutions, scripting, Infrastructure as Code, and AI-assisted engineering tools (Microsoft Copilot, Cursor).
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Ansible, Python, Terraform, AWX, CloudFormation, and other tools across cloud and on-premises environments.
* Design and support hybrid-cloud solutions, enabling seamless modernization of legacy workloads and adoption of cloud-native services.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure and platform issues, optimizing performance, resilience, and service availability.
* Communicate effectively with partners, providing insight into project status, risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
* Evaluate and implement emerging technologies to enhance system scalability, security, and cost-effectiveness.
* Identify, prioritize, and remediate infrastructure vulnerabilities while maintaining security and compliance standards.
* Manage and optimize multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises infrastructure using automation, configuration management, and security standards.
* Define and enforce infrastructure management policies, procedures, and guidelines for both modern and legacy environments.
* Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, and technical documentation in Confluence to support knowledge sharing and operational consistency.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 2-5 years of experience in infrastructure engineering and technical delivery
* Strong hands-on experience supporting enterprise Windows and Linux environments.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, AWX) and scripting using Python (preferred), PowerShell, or Bash.
* Solid experience with AWS and Azure cloud platforms; exposure to Google Cloud is desirable.
* Experience managing server lifecycle operations, including provisioning, onboarding, migration, and decommissioning.
* Understanding of operating system fundamentals including user and kernel space, memory management, shared libraries, file and network IO, Windows registry, software distribution, etc.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, Microsoft Copilot, or similar technologies to improve automation, code development, troubleshooting, and documentation.
* Awareness of emerging infrastructure, cloud, automation, and AI technologies, with a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.
* Experience with the project lifecycle of network integrations, infrastructure build, data center builds, and/or network hardware refresh.
* Good communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in Agile and multi-functional environments.
* Self-motivated team player with a continuous learning approach and passion for automation and innovation.

  
**Additional Information**

title: ITS Systems Engineer, Corporate Infrastructure Services, IT
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Corporate Infrastructure Services (CIS) builds and operates the systems that power Amazon's corporate offices globally — the networks, compute platforms, audio\-visual systems, and operational tooling that every Amazonian depends on. Our Systems Engineering function owns the operational standards, fleet governance, observability, and engineering practices that keep this infrastructure reliable, secure, and cost\-effective across a worldwide footprint.  

We are looking for a Systems Engineer with a focus on fleet management and operational excellence. You will own the operational health, compliance, and lifecycle management of infrastructure fleets — ensuring that our infrastructure device estates are accurately inventoried, properly governed, and operating within defined standards. You will be the person who knows what we have, where it is, what state it's in, and what needs attention.  

This role combines hands\-on systems engineering with fleet\-level operational thinking. You will troubleshoot difficult systems problems across hardware, software, networking, and cloud platforms. You will build automation that scales fleet operations — replacing manual processes with repeatable, reliable mechanisms. You will create and maintain the SOPs, runbooks, and documentation that enable consistent operations across a global footprint. You will identify patterns that affect fleet health, performance, and compliance, and drive improvements that deliver measurable results.  

You will work autonomously, taking ownership of problems even when they cross domain boundaries. You will be proficient across multiple technology areas — operating systems, networking, compute hardware, cloud platforms, and monitoring tools. You will use AWS services (EC2, Lambda, Systems Manager, CloudWatch, DynamoDB, S3, Fleet Manager) and scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, Bash) to build the automation and tooling that keeps fleet operations efficient and scalable.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own the operational health and compliance of infrastructure fleets — maintaining accurate inventory, tracking lifecycle status, and ensuring fleet governance standards are met
* Troubleshoot and resolve difficult systems problems across hardware, software, networking, and operating environments, driving root cause resolution
* Build automation that scales fleet operations — device discovery, compliance scanning, firmware tracking, health monitoring, and lifecycle reporting
* Create, review, and improve SOPs, runbooks, and documentation to ensure consistent, repeatable operations across sites and regions
* Identify patterns that affect fleet performance, reliability, availability, or compliance, and deliver automation that addresses them at scale
* Drive operational excellence initiatives that demonstrate measurable improvements to fleet health, compliance posture, and operational efficiency
* Provide insight to engineers across domains (software, hardware, networking, security) on how their components interact to form a system
* Participate in on\-call rotations, diagnosing and resolving operational issues across the infrastructure estate
* Mentor junior engineers, helping them understand systems architecture, operational practices, and fleet management disciplines
* Contribute to team design, scoping, and prioritisation discussions with informed operational and fleet perspective
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 4\+ years of site reliability engineering (SRE), systems engineering, systems administration, DevOps, security administration, or network administration experience
* 5\+ years of Linux experience
* 5\+ years of systems engineering experience
* Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related field or relevant work experience
* Experience in site reliability engineering (SRE), systems engineering, systems administration, DevOps, security administration, or network administration
* Experience in any of the following: Python, Java, Perl, PHP, Ruby, Bash, Shell or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of TCP/IP and networking protocols such as HTTP and DNS
* Experience designing and developing scripts to automate operational burdens and reviewing scripting changes to ensure they meet the standards for maintainability, scalability and security
* Experience working in 24/7 production environment
* Experience with service\-oriented architecture and web services
